meta.title: Log in
meta.description: Log in to the BlueGenji Esport member area with your Google account or a Discord code.

page.title: Log in
page.codeSeparator: OR GET A CODE BY DM
page.handleHelp: The bot has to share a server with you to message you: <join>join ours</join>, or use the Discord button above, which doesn't need one. Your ID only saves looking up your tag.
page.inviteAfterRefusal: If you're not on the server yet: <join>join the BlueGenji server</join>, then request your code again.
page.codeSent: Code sent by Discord direct message (expires at {time}).
page.tagNotice: This code saves this tag, without verifying it: nobody sees it.
page.pseudoHelp: Only used when your account is created: if you already have one, it keeps its username.

oauth.discordNote: Saves your Discord username, without verifying it: nobody sees it.
oauth.discordDetails: You can verify it later in “My profile” or in the window offered after logging in through Discord or Blizzard.

notice.IOS_INSTALLED_APP: From the home screen icon, iOS often blocks these logins. If it fails, open the site in Safari or use the Discord code below.
notice.IN_APP_BROWSER: This app's built-in browser often blocks these logins. If it fails, open the site in your usual browser or use the Discord code below.

advice.IOS_INSTALLED_APP: From the home screen icon, iOS isolates the login: open the site in Safari to log in, or use the Discord code by direct message.
advice.IN_APP_BROWSER: This app's built-in browser blocks the login: open the site in your usual browser (Safari, Chrome, Firefox…), or use the Discord code by direct message.

errors.BOT_INTERNAL_UNREACHABLE: Discord login unavailable (the bot cannot be reached). You can use Google instead.
errors.BOT_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT: The bot could not find your tag in time. If you are on the BlueGenji server, use your Discord ID instead; otherwise, use the Discord button.
errors.BOT_INTERNAL_UNAUTHORIZED: Discord login unavailable (invalid internal token). You can use Google instead.
errors.DISCORD_DM_FAILED: Could not send you the code by direct message: the bot has to share a server with you, and your direct messages must be open there. Join the BlueGenji server, or use the Discord button.
errors.DISCORD_USER_NOT_FOUND: Tag not found: the bot has to share a server with you. Join the BlueGenji server, or use the Discord button.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE_RETRY: Another request went through at the same moment: you were not signed in. Try again, with a new code if this one is refused.
errors.FAILED_TO_SEND_CODE: The code could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
errors.INVALID_DISCORD_HANDLE: Enter your Discord tag or your ID.
errors.CODE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED: Invalid or expired code. Ask for a new one.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODE_REQUESTS: Too many codes requested for this Discord account. Wait about fifteen minutes, or log in with Google.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODE_REQUESTS_TODAY: Too many codes requested for this Discord account today. Log in with the Discord button or Google, or try again tomorrow.
errors.INVALID_CHALLENGE: Code request not found. Ask for a new code.
errors.CROSS_SITE_REQUEST: Request refused. Reload the login page, then try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: Request refused. Reload the login page, then try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait about fifteen minutes, or log in with Google.
errors.DISCORD_AUTH_FAILED: Discord login failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.TERMS_REQUIRED: To create your account, accept the terms of use. Reload the page to see them.
errors.ACCOUNT_DELETED: This account has been deleted: its reactivation period is over, so it can no longer be reopened.

oauthErrors.unavailable: {provider} login temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
oauthErrors.params: {provider} login interrupted. Start the login again from this page.
oauthErrors.state: Login session expired or invalid. Start the login again.
oauthErrors.oauth: {provider} login failed. Try again in a moment.
oauthErrors.session: You need to be logged in to link an app. Log in, then try again.
oauthErrors.terms: To create your account, accept the terms of use, then start the login again.
oauthErrors.deleted: This account has been deleted: its reactivation period is over, so it can no longer be reopened.

suspension.title: Account suspended
suspension.spanUntil: This account is suspended until {end} (decision {reference}): you cannot log in while the suspension lasts.
suspension.spanIndefinite: This account is suspended indefinitely (decision {reference}): you cannot log in while the suspension lasts.
suspension.groundText: Terms of use, <terms>“{clause}”</terms>. Decision made by a member of the moderation team, with no automated processing.
suspension.appealText: Use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Other” (no login needed), quoting decision {reference} and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision. You can then take the decision to the competent court.
suspension.loginUntil: This account is suspended until {end}. The reason was sent to you by Discord direct message if your account is linked to Discord. To appeal: use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Other” (no login needed), quoting the decision you received and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision — then, if needed, the competent court.
suspension.loginIndefinite: This account is suspended indefinitely. The reason was sent to you by Discord direct message if your account is linked to Discord. To appeal: use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Other” (no login needed), quoting the decision you received and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision — then, if needed, the competent court.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.termsUpdated: The terms of use have changed (version {version}, in force since {date}): <terms>read them again</terms> before accepting them anew.
consent.intro: To run your account, BlueGenji processes only the data strictly needed for the service you ask for:
consent.pseudonyms: Only pseudonyms (site, Discord and game usernames) and an avatar — no real name, phone number or address: an account created through Google now gets a neutral username, never your name, and a photo copied from Google or Discord stays hidden until you choose to show it. The ID of the provider you log in with (Google, Discord or Blizzard) is also kept for authentication, along with the language of the page you log in from (French or English), to write your push notifications and the site's Discord direct messages in that language — the exceptions are detailed in the privacy policy.
consent.gameNames: Your Overwatch and Marvel Rivals usernames are only used so other players can add you in game, never to compile statistics.
consent.noResale: No resale of data, no advertising trackers, no targeted ads.
consent.discordTag: Logging in with Discord saves your Discord username without certifying it: nobody sees it until you certify it yourself, in your profile or in the window that offers it after you log in.
consent.export: You can export or delete your data from your profile at any time.
consent.policy: Full details in our <policy>privacy policy</policy>. If you go back, no account is created; only the site's audience measurement may have counted your visit.
consent.terms: I have read and accept the terms of use (<terms>read the terms</terms>), and I declare that I am at least {age} years old.

authGate.title: Login required
authGate.body: This page is part of the competitive area. Log in to view it: you will come straight back here.

discord.title: A verified tag is visible to:
discord.referees: referees, while you're registered for a tournament that isn't finished;
discord.match: the members of both teams of your match, from the moment its opponents are known until its end, and its casters while the match is being played;
discord.asCaster: if you cast a match: both its teams and its other casters while the match is being played, in its “Contacts” and launch windows and on its page; its assigned referee, whether or not they cast the match, and the referees who neither play nor cast the match, from the moment its opponents are known until its end, in its “Contacts” window and on its page — its assigned referee also in its launch window, while the match is being played;
discord.asReferee: if you are a match's assigned referee: both its teams from the moment its opponents are known until its end, and its casters while the match is being played, in its “Contacts” window and on its page — the casters' rule if you also cast it (for the refereeing: necessary for the service once version 9 of the terms is accepted, with no separate objection — your referee objection, once upheld, still removes you from it; before that, legitimate interest: you can object through the report form);
discord.players: other players, only if you tick “Discord tag” in your privacy settings.

battletag.title: Hidden, your BattleTag can only be read in the “Contacts” window of your Overwatch matches, in their launch window and on the match page:
battletag.match: if you're shown as a contact (“Contacts” and launch windows): the members of both teams, referees and administrators, from the moment the opponents are known until the end of the match, and the casters while the match is being played;
battletag.asCaster: if you cast a match: both its teams and its other casters while the match is being played, and referees and administrators from the moment its opponents are known until its end;
battletag.asReferee: if you are the assigned referee of a match: both its teams, referees and administrators from the moment its opponents are known until its end, and its casters while the match is being played — both its teams only while the match is being played if you also cast it (you can withdraw from a match at any time; unlinking Battle.net or erasing your BattleTag would remove your refereeing of Overwatch matches, which requires the one from Battle.net);
battletag.launch: the launch window only opens for both teams, the casters and the assigned referee; the match page repeats the BattleTag of its team contacts (to the parties to the match alone), its casters and its assigned referee, to the same people at the same times as the “Contacts” window.
battletag.footer: To stop sharing it entirely, clear it from your profile (if it comes from Battle.net, unlink Battle.net first, after adding another way to log in if it is your only one).

reactivation.title: Reactivate your account?
reactivation.lead: You asked for your account to be deleted. The deletion becomes final on {date}: until then, you can still reactivate it.
reactivation.keptLead: Reactivating gives you back your profile, statistics, settings, username and avatar.
reactivation.kept: Reactivating gives you back your account: profile, statistics, settings, and your username and avatar, hidden everywhere since the request (if your username was taken in the meantime, it comes back, shortened if needed, followed by “OG”, for example “UsernameOG” — or “UsernameOG2”… if that is taken too, failing that your borrowed username: you can change it in My profile). An avatar that moderation hid or removed in the meantime does not come back. A suspended account can be reactivated too: it stays suspended.
reactivation.notUndoneLead: What was done when you asked is not undone:

notUndoneItems.teams: you left your teams (ownership handed over, team turned into a ghost team or disbanded);
notUndoneItems.organized: your organised tournaments changed organiser when someone could take them over;
notUndoneItems.registrations: your registrations for solo tournaments that had not started yet were withdrawn;
notUndoneItems.forfeits: your remaining matches in an ongoing solo tournament where you had never played were lost by forfeit;
notUndoneItems.casts: your casts, referee assignments and pending invitations and join requests were withdrawn.

reactivation.doneSuspended: Your account is reactivated, but it is still suspended: you cannot log in yet.
reactivation.expired: This reactivation link has expired or was already used. Log in again to get a new one.
reactivation.failed: Reactivation failed. Try again in a moment.
reactivation.doneLoginRequired: Your account is reactivated, but your session could not be opened. Log in again.
reactivation.declined: Your account is not reactivated: its deletion becomes final on {date}. Until then, logging in will offer it again.
reactivation.missing: No reactivation is waiting on this device. Log in: if your account's deletion was requested, you will be able to reactivate it.
reactivation.pseudoChanged: Your previous username could not be given back: you now have another one, which you can change in My profile.
reactivation.declineFailed: Your choice could not be recorded. Try again in a moment.
reactivation.metaDescription: Reactivate a BlueGenji Esport account whose deletion was requested, within {days} days of the request.
